Tesla now has June6 Reuters evidence of actual retail dip-buying during the feud and departure of the Optimus program head, rather than repeating June2 founder-return reassurance or June6 political-threat repricing. Circle separately has June7 SBI investment coverage; silver remains a short158-word carryover. Retain the basket for those specific developments, without inferring popularity rank from price.

Its158 regex words keep the original breakout as a brief continuation with updated own-card context and reversal risk; the new price is not treated as a new business or demand catalyst. It is a side item, not the full lead.

The Chinese-jeweller substitution story is the same June17 BusinessInsider report already used June18. Retain the160-word side as a short continuation that distinguishes physical demand from a rising futures price and keeps customer-choice, supply-demand and contract risks. No new operating result or measured popularity claim is asserted.

The precious-metals family occurs in four trailing reports, but this entry has a specific new June28 Bloomberg account of Americans selling gold coins while Asian investors buy. That regional physical-demand disagreement differs from June27 Fed-credibility and inflation-waiting insurance and June26 silver input-cost pressure. Retain the selection for the reported distributional mechanism, without extrapolating coin behavior to a unanimous global trade or assuming a metals slot is required.
